problem.current_state: GA evolves models for composite fitness (Brier + ROI + Sharpe). Best raw Brier = 0.22182 (S14). Checkpoint threshold = 0.21837. Gap = 0.00345.
problem.issue: Tree models (XGBoost, RF, CatBoost) produce systematically over-confident raw probabilities near 0 and 1. Post-hoc calibration is known to reduce Brier by 0.002-0.005 with ZERO retraining cost.
problem.opportunity: Apply temperature scaling (single scalar T) or isotonic regression on validation set AFTER GA picks best model. Report both raw and calibrated Brier in /api/status.

proposal.name: Post-Hoc Calibration Layer (Temperature Scaling + Isotonic)
proposal.implementation_location: hf-space/app.py — add calibration step after GA cycle reports best model

algorithm.step1: At end of each GA cycle, take best model from Pareto front
algorithm.step2: Split X_val into calib_set (30%) and holdout (70%)
algorithm.step3_a: Temperature scaling: find T* = argmin Brier(sigmoid(logit(p)/T), y_calib). Optimize with scipy.optimize.minimize_scalar(bounds=(0.1, 5.0))
algorithm.step3_b: Isotonic regression: fit IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds='clip') on p_raw, y_calib
algorithm.step4: Pick better of TS vs isotonic on calib_set by Brier
algorithm.step6: If calibrated_brier < best_brier_ever → trigger Supabase checkpoint
